## Research Projects

::: {.project-entry}
<div class="pub-title">InteliColheita</div>

**Problem.** Predicting agricultural harvest outcomes and supporting related field decisions typically relies on manual observation and historical rules of thumb, with limited use of computational forecasting.

**Context.** Research project, Universidade de Pernambuco (UPE), 2005–2006.

**My role.** Undergraduate research (iniciação científica) student for two years, supervised by Prof. Fernando Buarque de Lima Neto.

**Methods.** Neural networks applied to agricultural time series for crop-harvest prediction and decision support; a mobile data-visualization component using georeferenced GPS data.

**Outputs.** An intelligent decision-support prototype for crop-harvest prediction.
:::

## Selected Applied Projects

::: {.project-entry}
<div class="pub-title">Brazilian Public Software — Manual do Ofertante</div>

**Problem.** Vendors and public bodies offering software through the Brazilian Public Software program (Software Público Brasileiro) needed clear, up-to-date guidance on the process and requirements for listing software on the platform.

**Context.** Brazilian Ministry of Planning, Software Público Brasileiro program, 2016.

**My role.** Member of the Software Público Brasileiro team; technical lead for the version 3.0 update of the Manual do Ofertante (Vendor's Manual).

**Methods.** Technical writing and process documentation, in coordination with the program team.

**Outputs.** [Manual do Ofertante, v3.0](https://softwarepublico.gov.br/social/articles/0004/7028/Manual_do_Ofertante.pdf) (PDF).
:::
